trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Definition block, read in full. All ten categories clean: the closing sentence is a cross-reference to the follow-on remark (documented false-positive class), and its em-dash pair is a true parenthetical whose three-item content enumerates the actual sections of that remark rather than a reflex triple. RIGOR CHECK: the pentagon as displayed, Phi_q(u)Phi_q(v) = Phi_q(v)Phi_q(uv)Phi_q(u) under uv = qvu, is the standard Faddeev-Volkov form with the factors in the correct order -- correct as written.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: One precision note, not fixed (it is a mathematical characterisation, and it recurs in the follow-on remark so a fix belongs in both). 'This identity is the Yang-Baxter equation in exponential form' overstates a real but looser relationship: the quantum-dilogarithm pentagon is the 2-3 Pachner / associativity consistency condition, whereas the Yang-Baxter equation is the braiding consistency condition. They are connected but not the same equation, and the definite article plus 'is' asserts identity. Proposed softening: 'is the exponential-form counterpart of the Yang-Baxter consistency condition'.
